title: Automated Detection of Label Errors in Semantic Segmentation Datasets via Deep Learning and Uncertainty Quantification
mechanism: Component-level uncertainty meta-classifier flags predicted connected components without labels (missing labels) and unsupported labels.
adaptation: Component features for tiny crack segments: size, mean p(crack), ridge contrast, distance to nearest label, source, inactive adjacency; train meta-classifier on val, apply out-of-fold on train to find under-annotated crack segments that 1-IoU confuses with jitter.
min_experiment: Arm: ignore (or soft 0.5) flagged unlabelled crack components in train. Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metric: crack relR@2, components >= 20 px found, strict IoU. Kill: flagged-set precision < 30% on an automatic ridge-darkness check, or no relR@2 gain.
evidence: R: detects most dropped labels on Cityscapes and CARLA while controlling false detections; collection of real label errors released.
prior_overlap: none (no label-error detection run in BRIEF section 5).

alt_notes.adaptation: Run on out-of-fold predictions over train+val and the test set to rank suspected crack/inactive label errors per source; defines the 'clean' test subset objectively for the benchmark.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: label-error ranking; relabel nothing, drop top-ranked cells' crack loss. Baseline: house. Metric: crack IoU; for benchmark, per-source estimated label error rate. Kill (model use) if crack IoU < house + 0.008.

alt_notes.adaptation: Run with the existing ensemble on train, val and the benchmark test set to rank missing / spurious crack and inactive components; output an audit list, auto-flag cells like CSIR_00070_r8_c4 for a clean benchmark subset.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: audit list on train + val; drop or ignore top-ranked components and retrain house, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: crack IoU and recall of the 24 audit-flagged cells among the top-50 ranked. Kill: fewer than 10 of 24 flagged cells recovered.

alt_notes.adaptation: Score every train crack and inactive component with out-of-fold models and drop or down-weight the flagged ones, with no manual labelling. For the benchmark, audit the test and E1 labels in a later phase and publish clean subsets with the reasons.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: drop the top 5% error-scored train crack components, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill if there is no detectable difference. The benchmark audit is separate.
